description: Lock-safe bounded LRU / partial Go-build cache eviction (never touches in-use stores). A dry run that reports what would be freed unless apply is true; an apply that names no scope, tool, max_bytes or older_than_secs evicts every idle unit and also needs all: true.

all.description: Confirm an apply with no selector: evict every idle unit in every scope.

apply.description: Evict for real (default false: a dry run).

dry_run.description: Report only (the default); contradicts apply: true.

max_bytes.description: Evict least recently used units until the total is at most this size.

older_than_secs.description: Evict units idle for longer than this (seconds, or e.g. 14d).

partial_go_build.description: Evict old Go build-cache files instead of whole units.

tool.description: Only this tool's caches (e.g. go, gobuild, npm).
